basis: Research pivot audit; classification is relevance, not efficacy or a new validation.

H-01.reason: correlated errors are the base of all corroboration limits

H-05.reason: scaling by count is not the new variable
H-05.direction: scale responders by verified incident severity, contract on resolution

H-06.direction: activate specialists by incident-linked stimulus with fixed authorisation bounds (risk-adjusted depth)

H-07.reason: sim-support, null in LLM; the board is a central object for defence
H-07.direction: shared evidence board with provenance, trust weight and decay, for SOC-style triage

H-08.reason: quorum amplified false success in our tests
H-08.direction: multi-source corroboration (independent evidence types) before containment; tune k by cost of false containment vs delay

H-12.reason: iid stopping rules fail under correlation
H-12.direction: calibration of detection and containment stopping when sources share failure modes

H-13.reason: direct analogue of false positives and false closure
H-13.direction: keep as is; add a false-containment and false-all-clear metric

H-15.reason: diverse detectors and verifiers break shared blind spots

H-18.reason: agreement between alerts is not evidence of threat
H-18.direction: agreement among correlated alert sources is not corroboration; use independent confirmation

H-19.reason: memory is also an attack surface
H-19.direction: verified, provenance-tagged memory with expiry and quarantine; compare with unverified persistent memory

H-20.reason: null in LLM; useful as priority rule
H-20.direction: triage priority proportional to verified evidence quality, not claim volume

H-22.reason: k fixed readers limits what can spread
H-22.direction: bound who an agent may read; compare fixed vs threat-reactive neighbourhood (feeds defensive plasticity)

H-23.direction: route alerts to few specialists; measure missed-alert cost of a wrong route

H-24.reason: cascades of delegated work and alert storms
H-24.direction: keep; add alert and remediation loops as the branching process

H-25.direction: decay of trust and reputation of sources and edges after threat evidence

H-26.reason: null-llm in repair; surge is real in incidents
H-26.direction: surge reserve for incident bursts, activated by confirmed damage

H-27.direction: executable counter-evidence inhibits a containment or attribution proposal (inhibitory signal with threat information)

nat-bacterial-quorum-sensing.direction: act only when density of independent threat signals passes a threshold (corroboration)

nat-brain-energy-sparse.direction: few specialists per alert; cheap always-on detectors, costly investigators on demand

nat-clonal-expansion-contraction.reason: expand on verified threat, contract 90-95%, keep small memory
nat-clonal-expansion-contraction.direction: keep; responders expand on confirmed threat, contract, retain verified signatures

nat-dictyostelium-aggregation.direction: compromised or defecting agent: tolerate, contain, exclude by external control

nat-homeostasis-allostasis.direction: pre-emptive defensive posture raised by risk context, relaxed on resolution

nat-inactive-reserve.direction: cold surge capacity woken by confirmed incident

nat-informed-leaders.direction: weight agents holding verifiable evidence; guard against a compromised informed agent

nat-interaction-rate-foraging.direction: regulate patrol and investigation effort by the rate of verified positive findings

nat-kessler-cascade.direction: alert storms and remediation loops that create more alerts; caps and reaping

nat-penguin-huddle.direction: rotate which agents read untrusted content (limits exposure per agent)

nat-pheromone-evaporation-aco.direction: evidence and trust decay; stale indicators lose weight

nat-physarum-network.direction: rewire who-reads-whom by useful flow and by trust (defensive plasticity)

nat-recruitment-benefit-conditions.direction: when broadcasting an alarm pays vs when it only spreads noise

nat-reflex-vs-cortex.direction: tiered response: deterministic reflex playbook, cheap triage agent, strong investigator

nat-renal-filtration.reason: discard by default, reabsorb functional items
nat-renal-filtration.direction: memory hygiene: transient context dropped, only verified items persisted

nat-scale-free-correlation.direction: propagate verified findings fast, damp unverified ones

nat-shepherd-moons.direction: gatekeeper agents with rate limits and schema checks; compare with plain gateway controls

nat-speed-accuracy-quorum.direction: tune corroboration k by cost of false containment vs delay

nat-stigmergy.direction: evidence board with provenance and decay

nat-stop-signal-cross-inhibition.direction: inhibit the specific risky tool, source or action with threat information

nat-topological-neighbors.direction: bounded neighbourhood as a propagation limit

nat-waggle-dance-recruitment.direction: recruit investigators in proportion to verified evidence quality

nat-wound-healing-resolution.direction: keep; recovery verification and stand-down (see H-D13)
